commands.localweather.none: No storm cells in this dimension
localweather.configuration.title: Local Weather
localweather.configuration.farClouds.too: Draw clouds further than Better Clouds allows, with less detail far away.
localweather.configuration.cloudDistance: How far clouds are drawn, in blocks. Higher costs generation and GPU time.
localweather.configuration.detailDistanc: Beyond this, every 2nd cloud is drawn twice as big; beyond twice this, every 4th at four times the size.
localweather.configuration.stormTowers.t: Thunderstorms build tall towers of cloud with a flat anvil on top.
localweather.configuration.stormDarkness: Clouds inside storms are darker, so storms stand out from far away.
localweather.configuration.thickRainClou: Rain makes the cloud layer thicker.
localweather.configuration.highLayer.too: A second, flat cloud layer high above the normal clouds. It gets denser near storms.
localweather.configuration.highLayerHeig: How far above the normal clouds the high layer floats, in blocks.
localweather.configuration.cloudCover.to: How cloudy the sky is away from storms. Better Clouds' own value is 0.5; storms add on top.
localweather.configuration.preset.toolti: Fills in all settings when changed; each can still be tweaked afterwards. VOXY_TECTONIC is for very tall terrain and extreme render distances. CUSTOM never changes anything.
localweather.configuration.clouds.toolti: The cloud layer. Needs Better Clouds.
localweather.configuration.cloudHeightOf: Moves all clouds up or down from the dimension's cloud height (192 in the overworld). +160 suits Tectonic.
localweather.configuration.towerHeight.t: Height of the tallest thunderstorm towers above the cloud layer, in blocks. The anvil sits on top.
localweather.configuration.darknessStren: How dark storm clouds get, from 0 (not at all) to 1 (full).
localweather.configuration.skyGloom.tool: How much the sky and fog grey over as a storm's clouds build up, 0 to 1.
localweather.configuration.globalRainTin: Share of Better Clouds' own darkening of every cloud by the rain where you stand. 1 is Better Clouds' behaviour.
localweather.configuration.maxStormsNear: No new storms form near a player while this many are already within about 9 km.
localweather.configuration.stormFrequenc: How often new storms try to form. 1 is about every 2.5 minutes per player.
Share of new storms that are short showers.
localweather.configuration.thunderstormC: Share of new storms that are thunderstorms (warm biomes only). The rest are rain fronts.
localweather.configuration.wind.tooltip: The wind wanders between these speeds and carries every storm and cloud.
localweather.configuration.noRainAboveCl: No rain, rain sound or storm darkness while you are above the cloud base. Only affects what you see and hear.
